# hector-vector

> hector-vector is a free, browser-based vector editor. It runs entirely in a modern web browser, with no download, no install and no cost, and nothing you draw leaves the tab. It offers a full vector toolset: pen and path tools, boolean operations and Pathfinder, an analytic geometric stroker, variable-width strokes, gradients, tiling patterns, live effects, clipping and opacity masks, blend, symbols, multiple artboards, and text with web fonts and text-to-outlines, plus SVG and PNG export. An open-source desktop app adds AI image processing (upscale, background removal, image vectorization/tracing, restoration), batch processing, and a local library.

## What it is

- **Free**: free to use, no download and no purchase required. Open source (MIT).
- **Browser-based**: a web app built on SVG and ES modules. Open a link and start drawing. Everything is computed locally in your browser, and nothing is uploaded.
- **A real vector editor**: a genuine path-editing toolset (pen, nodes, booleans, strokes, gradients, effects), not a toy. A free alternative to paid tools like Illustrator for the core vector work.

## Key features

- **Draw** with pen, node, curvature, and shape tools; live shapes (rounded-rect, polygon, star).
- **Boolean operations & Pathfinder**: union, subtract, intersect; divide, trim, merge, crop, minus-back.
- **Geometric stroker**: outline stroke, offset path, expand, and **variable-width strokes**.
- **Shape Builder, Scissors, Knife, Eraser** for interactive path construction.
- **Blend**, **clipping & opacity masks**, and **live effects** (drop shadow, blur, glow).
- **Gradients**, tiling **pattern fills**, and **Recolor Artwork**.
- **Transforms & Repeat** (grid / radial / mirror), **Isolation mode**, **Symbols & instances**, **multiple artboards**.
- **Text** with system and web fonts, and **convert text to outlines**.
- **Place raster reference images** to trace over.
- **Open SVG**, and **export SVG or PNG**, entirely client-side.
- **Works on a phone or tablet**: a real touch shell, with selection-aware toolbars and press-and-hold for the actions menu.
- **Desktop app (download)** adds AI upscaling, background removal, image vectorization/tracing, restoration, batch, and a local library.

## Common questions

- **Is there a free vector editor online?** Yes. hector-vector is a free, full-featured vector editor that runs in the browser with nothing to install.
- **A free alternative to Illustrator?** hector-vector covers the core vector work (pen/paths, booleans, Pathfinder, gradients, effects, text-to-outlines, SVG/PNG export) at no cost, in the browser.
- **Can I edit an SVG in the browser?** Yes. Open an `.svg` and edit it directly, then export SVG or PNG when done. All client-side.
- **Can I trace/vectorize an image for free?** You can place a raster as a reference layer and draw over it in the browser for free. Automatic image vectorization (tracing) runs in the free open-source **desktop app**.
- **Does it work on a phone?** Yes. The browser build has a real touch layout, not a shrunken desktop one.
- **Is it private?** Yes. The browser editor computes everything locally, and your artwork never leaves the tab.
